About promoting the "wage increase support subsidy package"

The Saitama Labour Bureau is working to spread awareness of the "wage increase support subsidy package" for small and medium-sized enterprises and small business operators.

In particular, the "Business Improvement Subsidy" is a system that provides partial assistance with costs when a workplace raises its minimum wage and makes equipment investments that contribute to productivity improvement. It supports both minimum wage increases and productivity improvements at the same time.

Eligible: Small and medium-sized enterprises and small business operators
Content: Subsidies for minimum wage increases and equipment investment

For details and application methods, please contact a management guidance officer at the Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry. Information about the "wage increase support subsidy package" is also available on the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare website.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2707/
